field_types.name: Exact Text
field_types.instructions: Extract text exactly as it appears in the document. Preserve punctuation, capitalization, IDs, phone formatting, and account identifiers.

field_types.name: Date
field_types.instructions: Extract dates from the document and normalize them as dates. Accept numeric and written date formats.

field_types.name: Number
field_types.instructions: Extract numeric values only. Do not include labels or surrounding explanatory text.

field_types.name: Boolean Checkbox
field_types.instructions: Return true when the corresponding checkbox or selection is marked, such as [X]. Return false only when the document explicitly shows the option is not selected.

label_group.name: New Hire Paperwork
label_group.instructions: Extract onboarding data from physician or provider new hire paperwork. Use values from the form tables and signature block. Ignore page headers, footers, page numbers, synthetic-data notices, and the diagonal SAMPLE - NOT VALID watermark unless a field specifically asks for that content. Do not infer values that are not present.
